searchText: You can query the client's metrics API, I reckon that could be one way. There's grafana, prometheus for remote monitoring, idk what performance parameters you want to track Hey! If the program starts in 10th June, why are some people already adding some development updates? I was mostly interested in seeing how much time each function/process takes and then finding the performance bottlenecks and optimization points. I think I can do that using Geth's timers, but if you know a simpler way please let me know. I think the "week 0" column is where you can post an update in, if you already have some ideas or goals in mind, or want to get a headstart. otherwise you can just start from next week in "week 1".
